The '''Sun Palace''', also known as the '''Palace of the Rising Sun in Splendor''', is the royal palace of [[Cairhien]], and the residence of the Cairhienin royal family. It is also the location of the [[Sun Throne]] of Cairhien.

== Appearance ==
Perfectly centered in the center of the city of Cairhien, the Sun palace's outer walls form a perfect square of dark coloring.  There are many colonnaded walkways around the palace and its windows are tall and narrow creating a feeling of rigidity. There are several gray stepped towers around the palace also designed in perfect squares. The main enterance of the palace is up a long broad ramp, past tall bronze gates, and a square courtyard. <ref>The Fires of Heaven, chapter 46</ref>{{Stub}}
